Google BigQuery • GA4 • Looker Studio 68.43% Cart Abandonment Isolated

E-Commerce User Behavior & Conversion Funnel Optimization

Engineered an end-to-end analytics pipeline in Google BigQuery and SQL, flattening and modeling 400,000+ raw GA4 event records into a scalable Star Schema data warehouse to diagnose checkout drop-offs and power market-basket cross-selling strategies.

Raw GA4 Rows
400,000+
Cart Drop-off
68.43%
Data Model
Star Schema

Click any table node below to inspect how raw nested GA4 JSON arrays were flattened into a query-optimized Star Schema:

TABLE: analytics_prod.fact_ga4_events Partitioned by event_date • Clustered by event_name

Flattens nested GA4 `event_params` and `items` repeated records into a clean analytical fact table tracking `session_start`, `view_item`, `add_to_cart`, `begin_checkout`, and `purchase` events with revenue metrics.

event_timestamp user_pseudo_id ga_session_id event_name device_category purchase_revenue_usd
BigQuery Standard SQL — GA4 Flattening & Funnel Conversion 
WITH flattened_ga4 AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    event_name,
    device.category AS device_category,
    geo.country AS country,
    ecommerce.purchase_revenue AS revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
),
session_funnel AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, '-', CAST(session_id AS STRING)) AS session_key,
    device_category,
    MAX(IF(event_name = 'view_item', 1, 0)) AS viewed_item,
    MAX(IF(event_name = 'add_to_cart', 1, 0)) AS added_to_cart,
    MAX(IF(event_name = 'begin_checkout', 1, 0)) AS began_checkout,
    MAX(IF(event_name = 'purchase', 1, 0)) AS purchased
  FROM flattened_ga4
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  device_category,
  COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(added_to_cart) AS cart_sessions,
  SUM(purchased) AS purchase_sessions,
  ROUND((1 - SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(purchased), SUM(added_to_cart))) * 100, 2) AS cart_abandonment_pct
FROM session_funnel
WHERE added_to_cart = 1
GROUP BY 1;
